summary: Indonesia Energy Corporation Limited furnished a Form 6-K on October 6, 2026, attaching a press release announcing that President Frank Ingriselli led a delegation to the Kruh Block in Sumatra to mark oil production from the recently drilled K-29 well. The team also visited the WK-5 location, where site setup and rig assembly are underway, targeting spudding by month-end to roughly 5,200 feet versus K-29's 3,400 feet. The release tests deeper formations from 3-D seismic, including possible natural gas. No transaction, stake, price, advisor, or board recommendation is disclosed; no risk-arb angle applies.
